citation: Sri Lanka Facts. Census Atlas 2024 private preview (v2026.11.10-preview.1).

indicator.definition: Total population divided by the land area of the unit in square kilometres. Area is computed from the COD-AB v03 boundary in EPSG:5235 (SLD99), not from the census table. Density is shown for context, not as a census count.
indicator.name: Population density
